task.title: Customize the daily digest email notification time
task.shortdesc: You can choose to receive a summary of triggered application events occurring in your Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console services in a daily digest email, instead of being notified as events occur.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Hybrid Cloud Console as an Organization Administrator or as a user with Notifications administrator permissions. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .

prereq.p: By default, the daily digest is sent at 00:00 Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

Organization Administrators and Notifications administrators can customize the time the daily digest is sent. The daily digest provides a snapshot of events occurring over a 24-hour time frame, starting from the time you specify in the notifications settings.

step.cmd: In the Hybrid Cloud Console, navigate to Settings > Notifications > Notification PreferencesSettings > Notifications > Notification Preferences. The My Notifications page appears.
In the Hybrid Cloud Console, navigate to Settings > Notifications > My User PreferencesSettings > Notifications > My User Preferences. The My Notifications page appears.
On the My Notifications page, click Edit time settings.
Select Custom time and then specify the time and time zone to send your account’s daily digest email.
Click Save. The daily digest email is sent each day at the time you selected.

info.note: After you save a new time, the Hybrid Cloud Console converts the new time to the UTC time zone.
